context: A list where v toggles details

checklist.name: handles_v_quit_binding
checklist.description: Accounts for the list's default `Quit` binding, which is `v` in Bubbles v2.2.x: calls `DisableQuitKeybindings()`, rebinds or disables `KeyMap.Quit`, or intercepts `v` before the list's `Update`.

checklist.name: toggles_verbose
checklist.description: Pressing `v` toggles a verbose flag that changes what is displayed.

checklist.name: forwards_messages
checklist.description: Forwards other messages to the list's `Update` and stores the returned model.
